lastaid.tutorial.notice: 教程 - 没有真正的价值
lastaid.tutorial.welcome: 欢迎使用‘急救’模组！本教程将指导您完成此mod并解释不同的机制。
lastaid.tutorial.line1: 正如你已经注意到的，原版的生命值栏已经消失。它已被本系统取代。
lastaid.tutorial.line2: 你身体的每一个部分都有对应的健康值，如果你从高空堕落...
lastaid.tutorial.line3: 你的一只脚将会受伤！它将可能导致你获得一些负面的Buff，比如受伤的脚获得的缓慢，挖掘与进攻时的挖掘疲劳。
lastaid.tutorial.line4: 这些效果可以服用吗啡或者治疗伤口暂时忽视。
lastaid.tutorial.line5: 创伤则可以通过绷带或者石膏右击对应部位来治愈。
lastaid.tutorial.sleephint: 如果你躺在床上睡觉，那么你的身体将会进行少量自我恢复。
lastaid.tutorial.line6: 如果是一个关键的部位（头或者身体）的健康值下降为零时，玩家将会死亡。
lastaid.tutorial.line7: 在这种情况下，无论其他部位是否完好如初，玩家依旧难逃死亡的命运。
lastaid.tutorial.line8: 如果你想看到你当前的健康值与治疗情况，只需按下%s键打开这个界面即可。

lastaid.config.showvanillahealthbar.tool: 如果设置为ture,则原版的生命值将显示各部位的健康平均值。

lastaid.tip.commands.pain.label: 疼痛
lastaid.tip.commands.pain.detail:
疼痛强度与显示
动态：随伤势变化 + 命中叠层红脉冲
轻度：保持较轻疼痛
显示：hitpulse/vignette、blur、FOV、音频
示例：/lastaid pain display blur off
点击填入：/lastaid pain mild
lastaid.tip.commands.suppression.label: 肾上腺素
lastaid.tip.commands.suppression.detail:
弹体近失肾上腺素
Dynamic/Mild/Off 强度
视觉：仅边缘暗角 + 去饱和（可与吗啡饱和互相抵消）+ 轻微扭曲
点击填入：/lastaid adrenaline off
lastaid.tip.commands.medicineeffect.deta:
设定药物生效节奏
realistic：更慢更真实
assisted：平衡体验
casual：最快生效
点击填入：/lastaid medicineeffect assisted
lastaid.tip.commands.revivewakeup.label: 苏醒
lastaid.tip.commands.revivewakeup.detail:
设定被救助后是否等待苏醒
on 15：救起后 15 秒再起身
off：立即起身
点击填入：/lastaid revivewakeup on 15
lastaid.tip.commands.injurydebuff.label: 减益
lastaid.tip.commands.injurydebuff.detail:
全局或按效果调整受伤减益
全局示例：/lastaid injurydebuff normal
单效果示例：/lastaid injurydebuff minecraft:slowness off
lastaid.tip.commands.damagepart.label: 测试伤害
lastaid.tip.commands.damagepart.detail:
调试命令，对指定部位造成伤害或治疗
示例：/damagePart HEAD 4
不触发减益：/damagePart HEAD 4 nodebuff
lastaid.tip.commands.naturalregen: /lastaid naturalregen off|limited|limited2|full [critical|random] - 配置自然回血
lastaid.tip.commands.naturalregen.label: 自然回血
lastaid.tip.commands.naturalregen.detail:
设置自然回血
full：可回复到绿色
limited：只能回复到黄色
limited2：同 limited，但跳过血量为 0 的部位
off：关闭
critical：头/躯干黄色及以下时优先
random：随机恢复可治疗部位
点击填入：/lastaid naturalregen limited critical
lastaid.command.pain.display.vignette.on: 已启用命中叠层红色疼痛脉冲
lastaid.command.pain.display.vignette.of: 已关闭命中叠层红色疼痛脉冲
lastaid.tip.commands.addiction.label: 成瘾
lastaid.tip.commands.addiction.detail:
仅管理员可查询/设置成瘾值
查询：/lastaid addiction <玩家>
设置：/lastaid addiction set <玩家> <0-100>
普通玩家不能查看自己的成瘾值
点击填入：/lastaid addiction set @s 0
lastaid.config.hideplayermodelindicators: 隐藏人形HUD状态指示文字
item.lastaid.ice_pack.desc: Right click: use on yourself, right click a player: use on them. Stops a nausea attack and speeds up recovery. Chills an uncovered head.
item.lastaid.herbal_tea_blend.desc: Brew it on a campfire, smoker or furnace
item.lastaid.herbal_tea.desc: Warms you right away (+1.5 C) and slows cooling for 3 minutes. Calming, heals the head a bit, stops one sneeze
item.lastaid.bark.desc: Sometimes falls off when stripping logs with an axe
item.lastaid.bark_broth.desc: Slowly restores the head. Does not remove symptoms
item.lastaid.head_bandage.desc: Worn instead of a helmet. Speeds up recovery even while walking. Tears when the head is hit
item.lastaid.neck_brace.desc: Freezes a concussion: it can't get worse or better. For carrying the injured. Can be put on another player
item.lastaid.medical_kit.desc: Only on another player (right click). 8 second procedure, both must stand still. Severity III needs a helper
lastaid.concussion.cured: Your head is clear - the concussion is gone
lastaid.concussion.relapse: You pushed yourself too hard - the concussion is back. Rest!
lastaid.concussion.no_sleep_cold: Too cold and too sick to fall asleep
lastaid.concussion.no_sleep_alone: Too hard, you need someone nearby
lastaid.concussion.cant_run: Your head spins - you can't run
lastaid.concussion.effects.2: nausea, slowness II, weakness, blindness flashes
lastaid.concussion.effects.3: nausea, slowness II, weakness, blindness, fainting
lastaid.concussion.detail.description: A head injury has shaken your brain. The best medicine is rest: lie in a bed in a dark, quiet, warm room. Pills and golden apples won't help.
lastaid.concussion.detail.symptoms2.4: Swaying camera, items slip from your hand
lastaid.concussion.detail.symptoms3.3: The head does not regenerate, chat text blurs
lastaid.concussion.detail.helps.1: Lying in bed, light <= 4, no monsters nearby
lastaid.concussion.detail.helps.4: Ice pack, herbal tea, head bandage
lastaid.concussion.detail.hurts.1: Sprinting, jumping, fighting (>5 min a day = relapse)
lastaid.concussion.detail.hurts.2: Any damage, bright light, noise and thunder
lastaid.concussion.detail.no_progress: You are not recovering right now
lastaid.concussion.detail.head_low: Head too damaged - no improvement until head HP is back to half
lastaid.concussion.detail.hardcore: Hardcore: severe concussions don't heal by themselves
lastaid.concussion.detail.spasms: Hypothermia + severe trauma: spasms, sleeping impossible
lastaid.medical.need_companion: You can't manage alone - you need someone nearby
lastaid.medical_kit.not_self: The medical kit can't be used on yourself
lastaid.medical_kit.need_helper: Severe trauma: a third player must hold the patient
lastaid.medical_kit.done_patient: You have been treated. Feeling better
lastaid.gui.row.fatigue.tooltip: Time since you last slept (phantoms come after 3 days)
advancements.lastaid.medical.root.title: Medicine
advancements.lastaid.medical.root.descri: Protect your head in the endless winter
advancements.lastaid.medical.bed_rest.de: Recover from a concussion without any medicine
advancements.lastaid.medical.doctor_said: Treat another player with a medical kit
advancements.lastaid.medical.back_to_nor: Recover after two or more relapses
advancements.lastaid.medical.head_not_he: A Head Is Not a Helmet
Get a severe concussion while wearing a netherite helmet
item.lastaid.antiviral.desc: 4 doses, at most one per in-game day. Speeds up common cold recovery x2 for a day (the cold heals without it too)
item.lastaid.surgical_knife.desc: Amputates a dead limb: right click - yourself, right click a player - them. Needs a medical kit and 2 bandages, 15 seconds standing still
lastaid.hypothermia.faint: Your legs give way from the cold...
lastaid.hypothermia.detail.description: Your body is losing heat. Clothing only slows cooling down - only a warm place can warm you: campfire, furnace, a house.
lastaid.hypothermia.detail.stage2: More slowness, common cold risk starts
lastaid.hypothermia.detail.stage3: Slowness II, slower mining, frostbite risk for arms and legs
lastaid.hypothermia.detail.stage4: Slowness II, weakness, fatigue, fainting, fast frostbite
lastaid.hypothermia.detail.helps.1: Campfire, furnace, lava nearby, a warm house
lastaid.hypothermia.detail.helps.2: Herbal tea: +1.5 C and half as fast cooling
lastaid.hypothermia.detail.hurts.1: Wet clothes, water, snow and wind
lastaid.hypothermia.detail.hurts.2: Hunger and no sleep - you freeze faster
lastaid.hypothermia.detail.borders: Borders: chilly < %s, cold < %s, very cold < %s, hypothermia < %s C
lastaid.cold.risk.hint: Find warmth before you catch a cold
lastaid.cold.risk.detail: You have been freezing for a while. If you don't warm up you will catch a cold. The risk slowly goes away while you are warm.
lastaid.cold.detail.description: A common cold. It heals by itself, but only while you are warm (body 36.5 C or more). Medicine only speeds it up.
lastaid.cold.detail.stage2: Slowness, weakness, sneezing every 30-45 s - monsters within 12 blocks hear it
lastaid.cold.detail.stage3: Slowness II, weakness, fatigue, sneezing every 15-20 s (heard within 20 blocks), you may drop items
lastaid.cold.detail.helps.2: Herbal tea - recovery x1.5 while active
lastaid.cold.detail.helps.3: Antiviral - recovery x2 for a day
lastaid.cold.detail.hurts.1: Getting cold again - recovery restarts and it may get worse
lastaid.cold.cough_drop: You coughed and dropped your item
lastaid.frostbite.need_bandage: Needs a bandage or plaster on this limb
lastaid.frostbite.need_medkit: Needs a medical kit (applied by a friend)
lastaid.frostbite.detail.amputated_arm: The arm is gone. No fighting, weapons, tools, bows or shields with it. Eating, drinking, blocks, torches and buckets still work.
lastaid.frostbite.detail.amputated_leg: The leg is gone: no sprinting or jumping, very slow. Without both legs you can only crawl.
lastaid.frostbite.detail.description: Tissue damaged by cold. Only warmth heals it (body 36.5 C or near fire); regeneration potions and golden apples don't help.
lastaid.frostbite.detail.arm2: Attack -25%, mining -20%, inaccurate bow, the arm loses HP
lastaid.frostbite.detail.arm3: Attack -50%, mining -50%, the shield can't block, the arm loses HP fast
lastaid.frostbite.detail.arm4: Dead arm: no weapons, tools, bow, shield or fighting. Eating, drinking, blocks, torch, bucket still work
lastaid.frostbite.detail.leg2: Walking -10%, jumps 20% lower, the leg loses HP
lastaid.frostbite.detail.leg3: Walking -20%, jumps 40% lower, the leg loses HP fast
lastaid.frostbite.detail.leg4: Dead leg: no sprinting or jumping, very slow. Both legs: crawling
lastaid.frostbite.detail.heal2: Warmth + a bandage on the limb: ~30 minutes
lastaid.frostbite.detail.heal4: Warmth + medical kit: ~1 hour (permanent limb death is disabled)
lastaid.frostbite.detail.heal4_permanent: Nothing. Amputation stops the infection risk
lastaid.frostbite.detail.hurts: Getting cold again resets healing. Frostbitten limbs take double damage
lastaid.medical.not_needed_kit: No need for a medical kit right now
lastaid.amputation.disabled: No amputation needed: dead limbs can heal on this server
lastaid.amputation.missing: Needs a medical kit and bandages (%s)
lastaid.gui.row.feels_like.tooltip: Air temperature as felt through your clothing (ColdSweat)
lastaid.gui.row.feels_like.wet: You are wet - you freeze faster
lastaid.gui.row.clothing.tooltip: ColdSweat clothing insulation: slows cooling down but does not warm you
